messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary metrics: /v1/generate p95 latency = 1.9x baseline on model redwood-3b-quant. Policy recommendation: automatic rollback to v2.3.1 (triggered by kernel OOM indicators).
Mia: seeing the spike in observability too. sampling looks odd — high seq lengths in one slice.
Alex: before we let the auto-rollback run, can we verify whether real user traffic is affected? last deploy at 09:02 UTC.
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback policy: enabled. Condition: p95 > 1.5x for > 5m -> rollback. Current alert age: 4m.
Sam (sre): marking as noisy candidate. Synthetic load tool started around 09:00 and often produces long-context requests. Alex, can you run `./tools/slice-inspect --route /v1/generate --last 10m`?
Alex: output snippet: ```
slices=6
slice-1: qps=18, avg_len=48
slice-2: qps=5, avg_len=1400  # synthetic long-context
slice-3: qps=3, avg_len=36
note: slice-2 tagged synthetic-test by runner
```
Priya (product): if it's synthetic-only we should avoid an auto rollback; customer-facing flaps are bad. Suggest pin prod traffic to 2.3.0 while canary stays on 2.3.3 for diagnostics.
Sam (sre): agree. Proposed action: `rwctl pin --route /v1/generate --version 2.3.0 --scope production` then keep canary at 2.3.3 at 10% limited slice (non-EU). Also create incident INF-4721 and notify support.
Mia: +1. I'll open the incident and add the reproducible steps. Also posting an immediate note to #customer-ops.
Jordan (legal): quick note: if we change routing for EU, we need the short EU comms template. Pinning to previous GA version is OK, just loop me in the announcement.
Alex: checked kernel logs on runtime nodes: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime | grep -i oom | tail -n 50` -> only warnings from the synthetic runner, no new OOMs in customer-serving pods.
Sam (sre): running dry-run: `rwctl pin --route /v1/generate --version 2.3.0 --scope production --dry-run` -> dry-run OK. Will apply in 20s unless objections. If anything else spikes we will let auto-rollback run.
Priya (product): drafting short release note: "Temporary production pin to v2.3.0 for /v1/generate due to elevated latency observed on synthetic long-context workloads. No user impact expected." Will prep customer note if prod behavior changes.
deploy-bot: Action applied: `rwctl pin` executed by Sam at 09:16:40 UTC. Production traffic: 100% -> v2.3.0. Canary: 10% -> v2.3.3 (synthetic slice only).
Alex: monitoring shows prod p95 returned to baseline immediately after pin. Canary slice still high due to synthetic test.
Mia: incident INF-4721 created and linked: https://incidents/redwood/INF-4721. CS pinged.
Sam (sre): decision summary: manual pin to avoid noisy auto-rollback. Follow-ups: 1) Exclude or tag synthetic slices in monitoring to avoid single-slice triggers. 2) Modify auto-rollback policy to require cross-slice confirmation (>=2 slices) before action. 3) Run postmortem for the deploy and synthetic runner coordination. Filing follow-up ticket: INF-4721-FU.
Jordan (legal): thanks  I'll review the comms copy.
Priya (product): once we confirm stable for 30m I'll update the public release notes and close the incident.
Sam (sre): closing thread: manual intervention prevented auto-rollback. Action items assigned. :white_check_mark:
